payload.entry: Repair complete: caller-scoped job identity (ci.yml caller-job input threaded to write_qualification_evidence --caller-job, GITHUB_TOKEN on both evidence steps, git rev-parse HEAD checkout SHA, preflight wheel version recorded before scan and carried when .venv is missing), run-scoped artifacts + --slurp via new collect_qualification_jobs fetch-evidence (concatenated streams decode, duplicate live artifacts refuse, conflicting payload bytes refuse), canonical candidate-gen{generation}-qualification-run{RUN}-attempt{N}.json draft asset written by --out and uploaded by basename with identical-no-op/conflict-refuse, command diagnostics preserved beside binding mismatch, fetch-error red keeps expected run/attempt and revalidates typed QUALIFY_RED rerun_eligible=false through qualify CLI and evaluate (steward adapter), rerun docs narrowed to first-attempt all-tests failures. Contracts for deployed-proof: observation asset candidate-gen{generation}-qualification-run{RUN}-attempt{N}.json; rehearse artifact qualification-observation-run-{run}-attempt-{attempt}; fetch-evidence --repo R --run-id R --attempts N --jobs-dir J --artifacts-file run.json --evidence-root E --zips-dir Z; verification: sase tool run check 4460fc1842cf377b80188593d42803ab succeeded (all lint gates + scoped lane, 177 focused tests green incl. new tests/test_qualification_transport_integration.py).

All six repair items implemented with executable integration tests: scoped job identity, run-scoped artifact transport, canonical draft asset, preflight version + diagnostics, fetch-error red identity, rerun docs. sase tool run check 4460fc18 succeeded; epic-symbols clean.

payload.entry:
DEPLOYED-PROOF STATUS at repair SHA 400572eab602681aa64f44653484a1dfc9ab0b38 (origin/master at start). Live rehearsals could not start: `gh workflow run release.yml -R sase-org/sase --ref master -f mode=rehearse` at 2026-10-20T05:12:52Z returned HTTP 422 because reusable ci.yml job `test` set job-level env `SASE_QUALIFY_EVIDENCE_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/qualify-session.json`. GitHub rejects the `runner` context there at parse time (`Line: 374, Col: 35: Unrecognized named-value: 'runner'`), so release.yml cannot call ci.yml. That is why Full CI / ci.yml runs at this SHA complete in 0s with "workflow file issue". The job-level env dates to 8afb1b7e57 (ci-evidence); this phase moved it onto the two test run steps, where `runner` is valid. Contract test `test_test_commands_and_plugin_activation_stay_reporting_only` now asserts the step-level path and that job `test` has no env map.

Also split the three QUALIFY_RED tests the repair added to tests/test_release_candidate.py (1034 lines, over toobig 1000) into tests/test_release_candidate_qualify_red.py; original file is 826 lines. Contract manifest recuration 83→84 redistributes those same tests. sase tool run check 4421a924749bdf13b133ddb7ea6bf706 succeeded (lint gates except toobig + scoped tests). epic-symbols clean.

REMAINING (do not close this phase until both live proofs and exact-SHA source comparison exist): after this runner-context fix is on remote master, dispatch `gh workflow run release.yml -R sase-org/sase --ref master -f mode=rehearse`, identify the run by dispatch time and headSha, retain URL/observation/manifest, re-evaluate through `release_candidate evaluate`. Probe core: published complete 0.34.48 (PyPI wheel+sdist; lacks pyo3 `bead_set_link_projections`, first tagged v0.34.53). Source pin dd817d5679409aaa2eefa0c3e517e8cfe91c37ef is sase-core origin/master and is contained in no published tag; sase-org/sase-core PR #333 (v0.42.2) is the in-flight daily cut. Do not credit a green qualification as satisfying that outer containment gap (already DISCOVERED ISSUE on sase-1n6). Observation asset: candidate-gen{generation}-qualification-run{RUN}-attempt{N}.json; rehearse artifact qualification-observation-run-{run}-attempt-{attempt}.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: tests/test_release_watch_health.py is 1253 lines and fails just lint toobig — reproduces identically at 54a9c14d23 (Master Gate lint job 118449395477, sole violation) and is owned by the toobig_split routine, not qualification. qualify-ci runs just lint, so a green rehearsal at current master cannot pass until that file is split. Do not treat a QUALIFY_RED caused only by this pre-existing toobig as a qualification-transport defect.

REPROOF REQUIRED (2026-10-23): compared SHA bdec291c77b0de1aab4c00abecef7430761db736. Green https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/40000653149, probe https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/40000657197, and source Full CI https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/40000661173 all completed failure at attempt 1. No reruns or further dispatches performed.

Acceptance mapping: file:explicit:88fe402c602e56f995848006. Full raw bundle (133 files, original candidate ZIPs, per-job evidence, complete paginated job/artifact responses, logs, local replays and digest verification): file:explicit:d1d05f2daface15a4c425e9f. Required-job/source/advisory summary: file:explicit:2c9807d13101d7e4f1920d8c. Individual deployed manifests: green file:explicit:8bc875efcb830c862a8c0a3d, probe file:explicit:9135aae02237170b0632e49b.

Both qualify jobs lost their observation upload because release.yml's inline asset reader was missing a closing parenthesis and hid stderr. Fixed asset/reason reads to pass filenames through sys.argv and retain diagnostics. Existing green/probe transport tests now execute the actual full workflow evaluate step and validate the upload outputs; both reproduced the old error, and all 32 focused release/transport tests pass with the repair. Required check is running under ToolRun 63ce16272c90ed2e5dca334ffbf86a98; its final verification note must precede closure. Actionlint reports identical pre-existing SC2012 findings on clean base and changed workflow; workflow-only validation passes.

LIVE ACCEPTANCE UNMET: green lint and test 3.12 passed; test 3.13/3.14 failed the modal-resize timeout. Probe lint names all nine missing bindings with installed 0.42.1 versus sealed/intended 0.42.2, but neither workflow retained an observation artifact. Local reconstructed QUALIFY_RED reports are diagnostic only: green has test-only rerun eligibility, probe is not eligible. Archived empty observation lists correctly refuse qualification/exercise and are not rerun-eligible. Source lint passes all 875 bindings from pin 246e28743538b6cd4d4e098b6960085c3e8ef5a9, but all three source test legs are red (3.12 also deck Ctrl-J timeout). Source is separately eligible for at most one test retry; none was consumed because this transport repair needs new aligned runs. Wheel exercise legs on both OSes also fail UPGRADE_NO_INSTALLABLE_PREVIOUS; sdist legs pass. Visual-test is advisory red; other advisories pass. Phase PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes retain existing owners and unresolved exercise diagnostics.

After the repair lands and unrelated blocking tests are addressed: fetch master, verify repair ancestry and current core completeness/containment, choose the nearest older incompatible probe if the pin changed, and ensure no release run is pending. Dispatch back-to-back `gh workflow run release.yml -R sase-org/sase --ref master -f mode=rehearse`, the same plus `-f probe_core_version=0.42.1` (only if intended remains 0.42.2), and `gh workflow run full.yml -R sase-org/sase --ref master`. Verify equal headSha, monitor under four hours, retain actual workflow observations and re-evaluate with the shared evaluator. No third release while probe is pending. Honor once-only test reruns, never retry missing/setup/lint failures. This phase uses the plan step-8 repair handoff after local verification; no ancestor is closed and none may claim acceptance from these red runs.

Outer DISCOVERED ISSUE #1 on sase-1n6 REMAINS OPEN. Published v0.42.2 independently contains the pin, but manifest/evaluator do not enforce containment; archived core_source_pin is still the requirement string sase-core-rs==0.42.2. Qualification does not fix that separate issue.

FINAL LOCAL VERIFICATION for the REPROOF REQUIRED repair: evidence file:explicit:e021a91a561c8a6e9a41f557 supplements the pending-check paragraph in mapping file:explicit:88fe402c602e56f995848006. The observation-reader repair passes all 32 focused release/transport tests, including two tests that reproduce the old deployed error before the fix. Formatting and diff checks pass. Required check 63ce16272c90ed2e5dca334ffbf86a98 completed exit 1: all lint stages passed; test lane 57,203 passed / 5 failed / 17 skipped. Stored triage is four KNOWN TUI failures plus one NEW artifact-tab descriptor assertion. That one passes on the unchanged repaired tree and on clean HEAD, with all 13 tests in its file passing on clean HEAD; the suite-context follow-up is recorded on the assigned phase. Original nonzero exit and NEW classification remain intact. No full-check rerun or workflow rerun was performed.

This completes the bounded plan step-8 repair handoff; only phase sase-1n6.5.1.5.2.1.2 is being closed. Deployed proof is still UNMET and REPROOF REQUIRED after landing the fix and addressing blockers. The raw evidence bundle is file:explicit:d1d05f2daface15a4c425e9f; the mapping retains run URLs, exact compared SHA, every refusal and redispatch steps. No ancestor is closed. Outer source-containment enforcement remains open.
